claims.exact_statement: For c*=29/2+4/ln(2), every finite-cube Boolean core f, every core-coordinate block X, every 0<eta<=1, and fresh fair activation F=A(f), a selector-root node with empty inherited block, opened block X union {z}, and core-child block X satisfies Delta_z L_c*,eta(F)+2(R-O)<=Phi(f)-Theta_X(f)<=0. If f already has a complete inherited-X SOLD tree, prepending this node gives a complete empty-history tree for F.
claims.scope_clarification: The result opens X at an outer empty-history selector and transfers X to the core child. It does not pay arbitrary pre-existing inherited history at an internal node, prove existence of the core SOLD tree, remove terminal reserves from stopped trees, or cover biased/nonfresh selectors.
claims.first_unproved_line: Every Boolean core and inherited block X admit a complete adapted physical restriction tree satisfying SOLD, or an equivalent universal aggregate bound retaining terminal reserves.
